For refactors, use existing smoke/source-root tests as characterization tests before moving logic.

assumptions: User approval to create roadmap/sprint metadata is sufficient planning source for this low-risk roadmap-only mutation.
No code implementation starts until a specific task is selected for implementation.
Existing old sprints are left unchanged; new remediation work starts at SPRINT-005.
non_goals: Do not delete code based only on current dead-code findings.
Do not implement any code changes in this planning loop.
Do not close or rewrite historical closed/cancelled roadmap tasks.
risks: Some future tasks intentionally touch large files; implementation should use artifact-status coordination before editing.
Review findings include false positives; TASK-037 must run before dead-code deletion decisions.
